fusions.name: Mail Picker
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Rivet Dart
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt at the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hardened Shell
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Last Stand
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 35% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
